reference.title: Virtual Machines - Get (REST API, Azure Compute, api-version 2026-04-01) response body of type VirtualMachine; corroborated by Virtual Machines - List All and the Microsoft.Compute/virtualMachines 2026-04-01 ARM template reference

$expand.description: 'InstanceView' retrieves a snapshot of the runtime properties of the virtual machine that is managed by the platform and can change outside of control plane operations. 'UserData' retrieves the UserData property as part of the VM model view that was provided by the user during the VM Create/Update operation.

delivery.note: This is an ARM control-plane REST response, not a push export. No blob path, partitioning, compression or manifest is documented because none exists for this surface.

unverified.name: GET response Definitions table (per-field type and required flags for nested types)
unverified.reason: The official Virtual Machines - Get page did not expose its type Definitions section in any retrieval attempt; the returned content stops at the Examples. The anchors #virtualmachine, #instanceviewtypes and #clouderror are referenced inside the page, so the definitions exist on the page but their content was never read. No field in this file is attributed to that section.

unverified.name: sku (top-level)
unverified.reason: Does not appear in any official GET/List All example response for Microsoft.Compute/virtualMachines, nor in the ARM template top-level property list for this type. Not listed, to avoid inventing a property.

unverified.name: properties.instanceView.*
unverified.reason: $expand=InstanceView is documented as a parameter, but no consulted official example returns the instanceView object, so none of its subfields (vmAgent, disks, extensions, statuses, computerName, osName, osVersion, ...) are listed.

unverified.name: properties.storageProfile.osDisk.managedDisk.additionalDiskProperties.managedDiskProperties.*
unverified.reason: The template reference lists the equivalent structure for osDisk but the child properties were only transcribed in full for dataDisks; not duplicated by inference.

unverified.name: required flag for every field other than properties.storageProfile.dataDisks[].createOption
unverified.reason: Only DataDisk.createOption is explicitly marked '(required)' in the consulted template reference: 'CreateOption' carries '(required)' in the Value column, and no other property does. Because the REST Definitions table could not be read, the remaining required flags are unknown rather than false.

unverified.name: read-only (readOnly) status of most properties
unverified.reason: Only properties.vmId, properties.storageProfile.imageReference.exactVersion, properties.timeCreated and identity.principalId/identity.tenantId have documentary evidence of being read-only (present in responses but absent from the deployment property list, or described as platform-assigned). For the rest the REST reference was not readable.

unverified.name: structure of resources[].properties.settings and .protectedSettings
unverified.reason: Examples show them as arbitrary objects; no schema is published.
